messages:
jess: AcmeRetail presales kickoff. They need: HMAC-signed headers, short-lived STS creds, streaming with function-call hooks, and pricing for sustained 1200 qps. Can we provide proto + SDK snippets and a security answer set?

sam: adding eng and infra. we'll need gateway copy-paste for key rotation.

alex: ill prepare tiny Rust + Node examples for signed headers on WS upgrade. note: 1200 qps with streaming+funcalls -> recommend Dedicated reserved pool (Starter may be under).

maria: legal asked about KMS, key lifecycle, and audit exports. i'll draft SOC2 answers if you give the flow.

ryan: ops note: rate limit by client_id+route; set max_concurrent_calls per session (50); batching_window ~10ms; prefix caching to avoid KV churn.

jess: acceptance test: stream 10k events in 10s, trigger function-calls, validate structured JSON outputs. action items: alex->snippets+cost estimate, maria->security draft, ryan->runbook bullets, sam->send RFP line.

build-bot: demo deployment scheduled -> presales-demo at 2024-11-06T15:00Z.

jess: thanks, sending to Acme. :thumbsup:
